title: heliotropium subulatum
intro: Heliotropium subulatum, commonly known as "false heliotrope", is a flowering plant species in the borage family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation, act as an antibacterial agent, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Heliotropium subulatum include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
